description: This file implements a CLI component for managing mesh network settings, specifically handling remote controller IP address input and validation, using the Bubble Tea framework for TUI and C Go bindings for external API calls.

classes.name: MeshSettings
classes.description: A model for the CLI mesh settings interface managing window size, remote address input, and validation state.

methods.name: newMeshSettings
methods.description: Constructor for MeshSettings, initializing the remote address input and associating dump and platform info.

methods.name: remoteAddrValidator
methods.description: Validates the format and value of the remote controller IP address string.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the MeshSettings model, returning the blinking cursor command.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles window resize and key events to validate IP address and communicate with C API.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Renders the CLI interface for IP address input with styling.
